name: Nathan Todd
occupation: Weston County commissioner and board chairman (re-elected November 2026)
prior_offices: Weston County commissioner (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026; listed as chairman on the official commissioners page)
background: Nathan Todd is chairman of the Weston County Board of Commissioners and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official commissioners page photograph identifies him as chairman. The News Letter Journal reported that he was one of three incumbents who won the August 2026 Republican primary, finishing second with 1,156 votes.

sources.name: News Letter Journal, Weston County certifies 2026 primary results
